theorems.name: Submission.dohr_tv_gmc_transfer
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Amb n ℓ)) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ U) (ξ : Amb n ℓ) (V' : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ ((fun x => x - ξ) '' U)), V'.weight = V.weight.map (fun x => x - ξ) → (∀ y, V'.tangentProj y = V.tangentProj (y + ξ)) → ∀ H : Amb n ℓ → Amb n ℓ, V.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature H → V'.HasGeneralizedMeanCurvature (fun y => H (y + ξ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
